_doc: A 20 tooth GT2 pulley for 6 mm belt with a 5 mm bore, the hobby part as Adafruit lists it: community until measured. Pitch and tooth diameters are Gates's: variant gates-2MR-20S-06 is Gates's own sprocket, stocked with a 3/16 in plain bore.
name: pulley-gt2-20

gates-2MR-20S-06.source: Gates Light Power and Precision Belt Drive Design Manual, copy at https://www.maxiparts.com.au/Documents/Supplier/Gates/light-power-and-precision-manual.pdf, Sprocket Specification Tables, 2mm pitch, 2MR-20S-06

teeth.source: Gates Light Power and Precision Belt Drive Design Manual, copy at https://www.maxiparts.com.au/Documents/Supplier/Gates/light-power-and-precision-manual.pdf, Sprocket Specification Tables, 2mm pitch, 2MR-20S-06

pitch.source: Gates Light Power and Precision Belt Drive Design Manual, copy at https://www.maxiparts.com.au/Documents/Supplier/Gates/light-power-and-precision-manual.pdf, Sprocket Specification Tables, 2mm pitch, 2MR-20S-06

pitch_diameter.rule: Pitch diameter, 0.501 in on Gates's table; teeth * pitch / pi
pitch_diameter.source: Gates Light Power and Precision Belt Drive Design Manual, copy at https://www.maxiparts.com.au/Documents/Supplier/Gates/light-power-and-precision-manual.pdf, Sprocket Specification Tables, 2mm pitch, 2MR-20S-06

tooth_diameter.rule: Across the teeth, 0.481 in on Gates's table (the hobby pulley measures the same)
tooth_diameter.source: Gates Light Power and Precision Belt Drive Design Manual, copy at https://www.maxiparts.com.au/Documents/Supplier/Gates/light-power-and-precision-manual.pdf, Sprocket Specification Tables, 2mm pitch, 2MR-20S-06

belt_width.source: Gates Light Power and Precision Belt Drive Design Manual, copy at https://www.maxiparts.com.au/Documents/Supplier/Gates/light-power-and-precision-manual.pdf, Sprocket Specification Tables, 2mm pitch, 2MR-20S-06

bore.rule: Bore of the hobby pulley: a NEMA 17 shaft
bore.source: Adafruit GT2 20 tooth 5 mm bore pulley, https://www.adafruit.com/products/1251

outer_diameter.rule: Rim (flange) outside diameter of the hobby pulley; sellers differ
outer_diameter.source: Adafruit GT2 20 tooth 5 mm bore pulley, https://www.adafruit.com/products/1251

body_width.rule: Overall width of the hobby pulley; sellers differ
body_width.source: Adafruit GT2 20 tooth 5 mm bore pulley, https://www.adafruit.com/products/1251
